title: [DEV] Crash when opening preferences
body:
Build: 1ab82b1157-2024.02.20 fulldebug
Pump: None

Steps to reproduce:
1. Remove AAPS or remove preferences
2. Open AAPS
3. Open preferences
4. Behold the crash
